places.name: Cozy Apartment
places.verdict: Cozy home, definitely can see myself living there but small living place
places.pros:
Lots of windows
high ceiling
right next to central park
places.report: It has a virtual doorman, right next to central park, very cute one-person place. Kitchen is in living area, but I can put divider. Last month (12. month) is free so it rounds down  $3,387/month. It's 5 floor walk-up and does it worth to pay that much for a cozy walk-up apartment with an amazing location?

places.name: Big and Amazing Apartment
places.verdict: Gorgeous apartment with separate kitchen, very big living space, king size bedroom!
places.pros:
Living room
Elevator
Doorman
Big bedroom
One block to riverside park
places.report: This place was super nice! It is exactly same as the listing images. Space is big, and the layout makes really good sense.

places.name: Not-so-great Apartment
places.verdict: Realtor lied about the layout and in listing the pictures were different!
